alzheimer's: Memory Decline, Learning Decline, Behavioral/Psychological Disturbance, Elevated Negative Mood
adhd: Reduced Behavioral Inhibition, Negative Emotionality, Developmental Delays, Executive Functioning Impairment
pica: Persistent Nonfood Intake, Persistent Non-Nutritious Item Intake, Culturally Unsupported
intellectual developmental disorder: Intellectual Functions Deficits, Adaptive Functioning Deficits; Onset Developmental Period
global developmental delay: Under 5 Years Old, Failure to Meet Expected Developmental Milestones in Intellectual Functioning
unspecified intellectual developmental d: Under 5 Years Old, Cannot Assess Specific Disorder Due to Age and Impairments
language disorder: Reduced Vocabulary, Limited Sentence Structure, Impairments in Discourse, Language Abilities Below Expected for Age
speech sound disorder: Difficulty with Speech Sound Production, Limitations in Effective Communication
childhood-onset fluency disorder: One or More of: Sound and Syllable Repetitions, Sound Prolongations, Broken Words, Words Produced with Excess Physical Tension
social (pragmatic) communication disorde: Deficit in Social Communication, Impairment of Ability to Change Communication to Match Context, Difficulty Following Conversation and Storytelling Rules
unspecified communication disorder: Clinician's Choice Not to Specify Reason for Communication, Neurodeveolpmental Disorder's Criteria Not Met
autism spectrum disorder: Deficit in Social-Emotional Reciprocity, Deficits in Nonverbal Communicative Behaviors; Deficits in Developing, Maintaining, and Understanding Relationships
paranoid personality disorder: Mistrust/Suspicious of Others, Begins by Early Adulthood, Overtly Argumentative and Complaining
schizoid personality disorder: Disinterested in Relationships, Disinterested in Sexual Experiences, Takes Pleasure in Few If Any Activities
schizotypal personality disorder: Eccentric Thoughts/Behaviors, Cognitive/Perceptual Distortions, Lack of Close Friends
antisocial personality disorder: Hostility/Aggression/Deceit/Manipulation/Disregard/No Remorse, Affinity toward Substance Abuse and Criminal Behavior, Violation of the Rights of Others
borderline personality disorder: Pervasive Fear of Abandonment; Identity Disturbance; Impulsivity in At Least Two Areas, Potentially Self-Damaging; Chronic Feeling of Emptiness
histrionic personality disorder: Excessive Emotionality and Attention Seeking, Increased Risk for Divorce
grandiose narcissistic personality disor: Arrogant, Entitled, Superiority Complex, More Talkative, More Aggressive, Low Levels of Sexual Satisfaction
vulnerable narcissistic personality diso: Egocentric, Contingent Self-Esteem, Distrust of Others, Socially Isolated, Low Levels of Sexual Satisfaction
avoidant personality disorder: Feelings of Inadequacy, Hypersensitivity to Negative Evaluation, Views Self as Socially Inept or Unappealing
dependent personality disorder: Excessive Need to Be Taken Care Of, Submissive and Clingy, Fear of Separation, Urgently Seeks Other Sources of Care
obsessive compulsive personality disorde: Preoccupation with Orderliness, Perfectionism, Inflexible, Not Open to New Experiences, Sometimes Hoarder Tendencies
disruptive mood dysregulation disorder: Frequent Outbursts and Consistent Irritable Mood, Challenges in Functioning due to Irritability, Diagnosis Must Be Made After 18 Years Old
major depressive disorder: For At Least 14 Consecutive Days: Loss of Pleasure in Previously Enjoyed Activities, And/Or Depressed Mood with SIGECAPS
persistent depressive disorder: Notably Previously Known as Dysthymia; Depressed Mood Most of the Day for More Days than Not for At Least 2 Years; Possible Poor Apetite, Insomnia, or Fatigue
premenstrual dysphoric disorder: In the Majority of Menstrual Cycles Experiencing Marked Irritability or Anger, Depressed Mood, Anxiety, and Sudden Tearfulness
bipolar i: Requires Presence of At Least 1 Manic Episode Lasting At Least 1 Week, Depressive Episodes May or May Not Be Present, Psychotic Features May or May Not Be Present
bipolar ii: Never Experienced a Manic Episode, 4-Day Duration of Hypomania, At Least 1 Depressive Episode, No Psychotic Features Present
cyclothymic disorder: Hypomanic and Depressive Symptoms Do Not Meet Criteria for Bipolar Disorders, 2-Year Period of Reported Low Symptom Experiences
schizoaffective disorder: At Least 2 Weeks of Psychotic Symptoms without Mood Episode, Can Have Mania or Depression Non Co-Occurring
oppositional defiant disorder: Anger and Irritability, Arguing with Authority, Deliberately Defiant or Spiteful, Must be Symptomatic with At Least 1 Individual Who is Not a Sibling
intermittent explosive disorder: Sudden and Intense Aggressive Outbursts, Not Premeditated, Lasting Less Than 30 Minutes, Experiences Guilt
conduct disorder: Repetitive and Persistent Pattern of Behavior Violating the Basic Rights of Others, Must Last Longer than a Year with At Least 6 Months of Physical Fighting or Physical Cruelty to People or Animals
pyromania: Deliberate and Purposeful Fire-Setting on More Than 1 Occasion, Tension or Affective Arousal Before the Act, Fascination with or Attraction to Fire in Situational Contexts, Not Done for Monetary Gain
kleptomania: Recurrent Failure to Resist Impulses to Steal Objects that are Not Needed for Either Personal Use or Monetary Value, Pleasure and Gratification at Time of Theft
delusional disorder: 1 or More Delusions, Functioning Only Impaired during Delusion, Not Longer than 1 Month
brief psychotic disorder: At Least 1 Delusion, Hallucination, or Disorganized Speech Episode; Can Last 1 Day - 1 Month
schizophreniform disorder: At Least 1 Delusion, Hallucination, or Disorganized Speech Episode; Can Last 1 Month - 6 Months
schizophrenia: Delusions, Hallucinations or Disorganized Speech Episodes with Disorganized and Catatonic Behavior; The Level of Functional Impairment is Significantly Below Premorbid Functioning; Lasts At Least 6 Months with 1 Month of Positive Symptoms
erotomanic delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but Delusions have Central Theme of Another Person being In Love with the Individual
grandiose delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but Delusions have Central Theme of Some Great but Unrecognized Talent or Insight on Behalf of the Individual
jealous delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but Delusions have Central Theme of Spouse or Lover being Unfaithful to the Individual
persecutory delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but Delusions have Central Theme of Individual being Conspired Against, Spied on, Followed, Poisoned, Maliciously Maligned, Harassed, or Obstructed in the Pursuit of their Long-Term Goals
somatic delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but Delusions have Central Theme of the Bodily Functions or Sensations being Affected
mixed delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but Has No Dominant Central Theme
unspecified delusional disorder: Meets Criteria for Delusional Disorder but No Central Themes Can Be Determined
catatonia: Must Have 3 or More of: Stupor, Catalepsy, Waxy Flexibility, Mutism, Negativism, Posturing, Mannerism, Stereotypy, Agitation, Grimacing, Echolalia, Echopraxia
obsessive compulsive disorder: Spends More Than 1 Hour Per Day Being Clinically Distressed or Impaired by Recurrent and Persistent Thoughts, Compulsions Aimed at Reducing Anxiety or Stress Caused by Obsessions, Disturbance is Not Better Explained by the Symptoms of Another Mental Disorder
checking obsessive compulsive disorder: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Preventing Harm, Mistakes, or Catastrophes
contamination obsessive compulsive disor: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions over Fear of Being Harmed or Harming Others due to Germs, Dirt, etc.
counting obsessive compulsive disorder: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions with Numbers or Counting that Feel Necessary to Prevent Harm or to 'Feel Right'
existential obsessive compulsive disorde: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about The Meaning of Life, Nature of Reality, or Death
false memory obsessive compulsive disord: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Someone Doing Something Bad to the Individual without Evidence or Memory
harm obsessive compulsive disorder: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Causing Harm to Self or Others with Knives or in Situations Like Pushing Someone in front of a Train, etc.
perfectionism obsessive compulsive disor: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Symmetry or Perfection in Every Area of Live to Avoid Unease
magical thinking obsessive compulsive di: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Beliefs that the Individual's Thoughts or Actions will Cause Something Unrelated or Bad to Happen to Someone Other than the Individual
pedophilic obsessive compulsive disorder: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Unwanted Sexual Thoughts about Children that Are Not in Alignments with their Values
perinatal obsessive compulsive disorder: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Causing Harm to a Baby during Pregnancy, during Birth, or in Early Postpartem
relationship obsessive compulsive disord: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions regarding Doubts or Fears about the Individual's Romantic Relationship even when Things Are Going Well such as Fears about Not Being Attracted to Partner Despite Evidence to the Contrary
scrupulosity obsessive compulsive disord: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions regarding Moral or Religious Failure
sensorimotor/somatic obsessive compulsiv: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Automatic Bodily Processing Intrusive Awareness
sexual orientation obsessive compulsive: Meets the Criteria for OCD with Obsessions about Intrusive Doubts about the Individual's Sexual Orientation Conflicting with their Established Identity
body dysmorphic disorder: Obsessive Concerns regarding Perceived Flaws and Repetitive Behaviors with respect to the Individual's Physical Appearance
rumination disorder: Regurgitating Food Repetitively and Quickly after Meals without Gagging or Retching
arfid (avoidant/restrictive food intake: Eating or Feeding Disturbance Associated with Signifcant Weight Loss, Nutritional Deficiency, Dependence on Enteral Feeding, or Oral Nutritional Supplements; Not Better Explained by a Lack of Available Food or a Culturally Sanctioned Practice
anorexia nervosa: Restriction of Energy Intake Leading to Significantly Low Body Weight, Must Include Intense Fear of Gaining Weight or Becoming Fat even though Individual is at Significantly Low Weight
bulimia nervosa: Episodes of Binge-Eating Followed by Compensatory Behaviors to Prevent Weight Gain
binge-eating disorder: Binge-Eating without Compensatory Behaviors, Typically due to Difficulty Coping with Emotions
delayed ejaculation disorder: Marked Delay in Ejaculation for At Least 6 Months, Not Better Explained by a Non-Sexual Mental Disorder or a Consequence of Severe Relational Distress
erectile disorder: Marked Difficulty in Obtaining an Erection during Sexual Activity, Marked Decrease Erectile Rigidity, Lasting At Least 6 Months
female orgasmic disorder: Marked Delays in or Absence of Orgasms, Not Better Explained by a Non-Sexual Mental Disorder or a Consequence of Severe Relational Distress, Can Be Life-Long or Acquired
female sexual interest/arousal disorder: Obsessive Interest in Sexual Activity with Female-Presenting Individuals, Obsessed with Erotic Thoughts or Fantasies, Lasting At Least 6 Months
genito-pelvic pain/penetration disorder: Marked Vulvovaginal or Pelvic Pain during Penetration Attempts, Marked Tensing or Tightening of the Pelvic Floor Muscles during Attempted Vaginal Penetration, Not Caused by Previous Trauma or Distress
male hypoactive sexual desire disorder: Persistent or Recurrent Deficiency in Sexual or Erotic Thoughts or Fantasies Determined by Clinician
premature ejaculation disorder: Pattern of Ejaculation within Approximately 1 Minute Following Vaginal Penetration, Must be Present in Every Sexual Interaction for At Least 6 Months
substance/medication-induced sexual dysf: Clinically Significant Disturbance in Sexual Function during or soon after Substance Intoxication or during Withdrawl
gender dysphoria: Marked Incongruence between the Individual's Experienced Gender Versus Assigned Gender of At Least 6 Months' Duration, Characterized by a Strong Dislike of Individual's Sexual Anatomy and a Strong Desire for the Sex Characteristics that Match Individual's Experienced Gender
alcohol use disorder: Problematic Pattern of Alcohol Use Occurring within a 12-Month Period with At Least 2 of: Alcohol Taken in Larger Amounts than Intended, a Persistent Desire or Unsuccessful Efforts to Cut Down or Control Alcohol Use, Significant Time Spent in Activities Meant to Obtain or Use Alcohol, or Important Social, Occupational, or Recreational Activities are Given Up or Reduced for Alcohol Use; Always Characterized by High Tolerance
caffeine intoxication disorder: 5 or More of the Following Symptoms Developing during or shortly after Caffeine Use: Intoxication, Restlessness, Nervousness, Insomnia, Flushed Face, Muscle Twitching, Rambling Flow of Thought and Speech, Periods of Inexhaustability, Psychomotor Agitation
cannabis use disorder: Problematic Pattern of Cannabis where it is Often Taken in Larger Amounts or Over a Longer Period than was Intended; a Great Deal of Time is Spent in Activities Necessary to Obtain Cannabis, Use Cannabis, or Recover from its Effects; Marked Increased Cannabis Tolerance
cannabis intoxication: Conjuctival Injection, Increased Appetite, Dry Mouth, or Tachycardia after Recent Use of Cannabis Causing Problematic Behavioral or Psychological Changes to the Individual
gambling disorder: Persistent and Recurrent Problematic Gambling Behavior Leading to Clinically Significant Impairment or Distress for At Least 1 Year, Gambling Behavior Not Better Explained by a Manic Episode
frontotemporal neurocognitive disorder: 3 or More of the Following Behavioral Symptoms: Behavioral Disinhibition, Apathy or Inertia, Loss of Sympathy or Empathy, Perseverative or Compulsive Ritualistic Behavior, Hyperorality and Dietary Changes
vascular neurocognitive disorder: Onset of Cognitive Deficits Temporarily Related to One or More Cerebrovascular Events
neurocognitive disorder due to hiv infec: Neurocognitive Impairment Following Documented Infection with Human Immunodeficieny Virus
voyeuristic disorder: Over At Least a 6-Month Period, Recurrent and Intense Sexual Arousal from Observing an Unsuspecting Naked Individual; Manifested by Fantasies, Urges or Behaviors
exhibitionistic disorder: Over At Least a 6-Month Period, Recurrent and Intense Sexual Arousal from the Exposure of the Individual's Genitals to an Unsuspecting Individual; Specify Whether Aroused by Exposing to Prepubescent Children, Physically Mature Individuals, or both
frotteuristic disorder: Over At Least a 6-Month Period, Recurrent and Intense Sexual Arousal from Thoughts of Touching or Rubbing Against a Non-Consenting Person that are Acted on At Least Once during the Time Period
sexual masochism disorder: Over At Least a 6-Month Period; Recurrent and Intense Sexual Arousal from the Act of Being Humiliated, Beaten, Bound, or Otherwise Made to Suffer; Must be Impairing Functioning
sexual sadism disorder: Over At Least a 6-Month Period, Recurrent and Intense Sexual Arousal from the Physical or Psychological Suffering of Another Individual, Must Cause Clinically Significant Impairment in Social Settings
pedophilic disorder: Over At Least a 6-Month Period; Recurrent and Intense Sexual Arousal from Fantasies, Urges, or Behaviors with Children; Must have Acted on these Behvaiors At Least Once; Must be Older than 16 Years Old to Receive Diagnosis
